notes.title: NEW.PATCH.ALERT.
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello players! [/h1]

We are back from a bit of a break with a fresh new patch!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34051325/82dae5adb94a179f9556c90138f8d7c010a82eaa.gif[/img]

[b]Here are the release notes:[/b]

[b][h1]Features:[/h1][/b][list]
[*] Versus mode: manager automatically imports other users’ programs 
[*] IF/CASE highlighting automatically selects the entire block of commands  and de-highlighting deselects the block of commands (thx [b]@programaths[/b])
[*] New AI behavior for MOVE BACK
[/list]
[b][h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1][/b][list]
[*] Reset progress bar after CLEAR
[*] Minor level fixed + optimization
[*] Memory and speed optimization
[*] Changes made to the Star Requirements for the Tutorial level "I'm proud of my flag"
[/list]

As always, thank you for your continued support and be on the look out for further updates!

Thank you for playing. :)

notes.title: IF.NEW.YEAR.THEN.NEW.UPDATE.
notes.notes:
[h1]Happy new year players![/h1]
As promised, here comes another update for RoboSnakes!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34051325/ca3ee558741f7047255a967ac4437898d72bc0e5.gif[/img]

[b]Here are the release notes:[/b]

[h1]Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Further improvements and optimization of tutorial levels
[*] Improving star requirements for various levels
[*] Support for multiplayer modes
[*] New, techno soundtrack added into the game
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Increased frame rate in different resolutions
[*] Sound effect levels improved
[*] Fixed ray effect problems
[/list]

We continue to work on adding new features into the game. All of your suggestions or comments are greatly appreciated! 

[b]We can’t wait to see the future of RoboSnakes going into 2019!
[/b]

notes.title: HELLO.PLAYERS.BIG.NEWS.COMING.
notes.notes:
The newest, promised big update for RoboSnakes: Core Wars Legacy will be arriving today, January 3. 

[b]Here are the release notes for the update:[/b]

[h1]Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improvements made to the various environmental objects’ AI, such as: 
[list]
[*] enemy RoboSnakes
[*] new types of Guards
[*] smart Exits
[*] different Boosters
[*] energy Cells
[/list]
[*] Changes made to the Campaign:
[list]
[*] 3 new, more challenging bosses
[*] variety added to the opponent strategies
[*] fine-tuning the 3 star solutions
[/list]
[*] Changes made to Versus arenas:
[list]
[*] variety added to the maps to enable more strategies to be viable in combat
[/list]
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved stability on Windows10 
[*] Support for Windows7/8 added
[*] Performance issues fixed for 5K, 6K and 8K resolutions
[*] Fixes made to the UNDO feature in the Code editor
[/list]

Thank you for your support, please keep in mind that we are always open to any questions or suggestions you might have on developing and improving the game!

[b]PS.[/b]
Mac users prepare for OS X support very soon!

notes.title: Steam Early Access launch
notes.notes:
Robosnakes: Core Wars Legacy is here! You can join us in the early access now and play it by yourself.

Please keep in mind that we are working intensely on improving the game as quickly as possible. Since this is Early Access if you experience any bugs, crashes, have any questions regarding RoboSnakes or find anything unclear, please be sure to contact us using the forums, disscussions or our support email support@robosnakes.com. We want you to have the best possible experience with our game, so don't hesitate to reach out.

notes.title: Delay!
notes.notes:
We are sorry to inform you that we need more time before release.
We are working hard to deliver you the best possible product. "A delayed game is eventually good, but a rushed game is forever bad".
The game will be released on 26.12.2019.
